topic.title: Treasure Map Game
topic.description: Places a treasure marker on a 3×3 grid by converting user row/column input to list indices. Introduces 2D lists and index manipulation.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Representing a grid with a nested list and modifying specific elements using row/column indices.
learningNotes.challenges: Converting 1-based user input to 0-based list indices.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Scale to a larger grid and add obstacles.

files.description: Places an X marker on a 3×3 grid.
